verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for an API management platform like Konnect, so the axis applies. The evidence covers AI Gateway features for proxying, governing, and observing LLM, MCP, and A2A traffic, plus a Konnect MCP server for external agents. None of it documents an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to; these are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.
